events.title: Tupac Shakur: 30 years since his passing
events.blurb: Remembering the influential rapper Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55 this year, 30 years after he was shot dead in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac Legacy
angles.copy: 30 years since we lost a true icon. Tupac's music and message continue to resonate, shaping hip-hop and culture. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix: Remembering a guitar legend
events.blurb: It's 56 years since the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84 this year, passed away.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Still unsurpassed. Today, we remember Jimi Hendrix, 56 years after his passing. His groundbreaking guitar work changed music forever. Which track defines him for you?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road released (1969)
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic 'Abbey Road' album, featuring tracks like 'Come Together' and 'Here Comes the Sun', was released 57 years ago today.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: Walk across that iconic zebra crossing! 57 years ago, The Beatles released 'Abbey Road'. A masterpiece from start to finish. What's your top track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Happy 75th Birthday to The Pretenders' legendary frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde, born today in 1951.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Here's to Chrissie Hynde, celebrating her 75th birthday! The Pretenders' iconic voice and attitude, still rocking. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Rock 'n' roll star Liam Gallagher, former Oasis frontman, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Mad for it! Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still bringing the swagger. What's your favourite Liam moment or track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' released (1975)
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem for peace, 'Imagine', was released 51 years ago today.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: Imagine all the people... living life in peace. 51 years ago, John Lennon gave us 'Imagine', a song that still resonates globally. What does it mean to you?

events.title: Apple released the first iPod (2001)
events.blurb: 25 years ago, Apple introduced the first iPod, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: 25 years ago, a quarter-century! The original iPod dropped, changing our pockets and our playlists forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes, which Bond film or song is your all-time favourite? Licence to thrill!

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the unparalleled talent and vision of John Lennon. His music still inspires generations. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Happy 87th Birthday to the legendary comedian, actor, and writer, John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: No silly walks here, just a huge Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! A true titan of British comedy. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released (1968)
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, famously known as the 'White Album', was released 58 years ago today.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles delivered the sprawling, brilliant 'White Album'. A true journey through their diverse genius. Which track do you always go back to?

events.title: Freddie Mercury: 35 years since his passing
events.blurb: Remembering the iconic Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 this year, 35 years after his death.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: The showman, the voice, the legend. 35 years since we lost Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80. His incredible legacy lives on. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released (1965)
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul', featuring hits like 'Norwegian Wood' and 'In My Life', was released 61 years ago today.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: A pivotal moment in music history! 61 years ago, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul', showcasing their evolving sound. What's your standout track from the album?

events.title: John Lennon: 46 years since his passing
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86 this year, 46 years after his tragic death.

angles.name: John Lennon Death Anniversary
angles.copy: 46 years ago, the music world lost a visionary. Remembering John Lennon today, whose messages of peace and love resonate as strongly as ever. His legacy is immense.
